decisions.series: One Base checklist combines all seven series at equal card availability. Physical ranges: 1–109, 110–196, 197–283, 284–370, 371–457, 458–533, 534–598.
decisions.variants: One standard card per printed number. Prefer corrected versions where identified and preserve source alternatives in the snapshot.
decisions.rookies: 47 unique TCDB rookie-index numbers. Apply player-specific exceptions from the source notes. Rookie Stars and All-Star Rookie are separate subset labels.
decisions.packFormat: VCS uses a five-card pack and 24-pack box. A Game hit occupies one card slot.
decisions.gameOdds: Model documented third-series Game distribution at one per eligible wax pack. Weight by the 87/598 third-series checklist share and round to 1:7 in the combined VCS pack. Later-series cello reports and occasional second inserts are outside this model.
decisions.excludedIssues: Proofs, separately sold Posters and Milton Bradley Win-A-Card printings are outside the standard wax product.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: Complete seven-series checklist, one card per printed number.

productSets.notes: Third-series wax baseline weighted to the combined pack. 1:7 is a VCS model.
